project.name: Markdown Quiz Generator
project.purpose: Obsidian plugin and Python application for studying terms and practicing Python from Markdown notes.
project.llm_guidance: Use markdown_quiz/ as the canonical Python source for CLI and development. The copy under plugin/markdown-quiz-generator/backend/ is the standalone backend bundled for Obsidian installation; keep it synchronized when publishing plugin builds. obsidian-markdown-quiz/src/ is the editable TypeScript UI source; its compiled output is copied to the plugin package.

directories.markdown_quiz/: Canonical Python package. Parsing, question generation, quiz sessions, storage, API, local model access and Docker execution.
directories.obsidian-markdown-quiz/src/: TypeScript source for the Obsidian plugin UI, HTTP client, session state, inline coding widgets and settings.
directories.obsidian-markdown-quiz/tests/: Frontend tests and Obsidian DOM/API stubs.
directories.plugin/markdown-quiz-generator/: Ready-to-install Obsidian plugin package: compiled JavaScript/CSS/manifest plus a self-contained Python backend and its runtime data. Backend code is a shipped copy, not the canonical development source.
directories.tests/: Python unit and integration tests for API, CLI, engine, quiz behavior, Docker sandbox, libraries and deployment.
directories.data/: Local CLI saved state: term records, code quiz records and settings. Runtime data; not source code.
directories.vault/: Small sample Markdown vault used for demonstration and development.
directories.deployment/: Docker Compose server deployment, deployment container image, local installer, server setup script and deployment guide.
directories.dist/: Generated versioned release ZIP archives for source, backend, plugin, local installer and server distributions. Build artifacts; do not edit by hand.
directories.plugin/markdown-quiz-generator/backend/d: Per-vault persisted state used by the packaged backend; generated/runtime data, not application source.
directories.markdown_quiz/notes/: Markdown parsing, saved records and synchronization.
directories.markdown_quiz/quiz/: Question selection, generation, grading, sessions and review scheduling.
directories.markdown_quiz/services/: Model-provider HTTP requests and Docker execution/library images.
directories.obsidian-markdown-quiz/src/quiz/: Shared session state and selection filters.
directories.obsidian-markdown-quiz/src/views/: Sidebar, inline widgets, rendering and editable blanks.
directories.obsidian-markdown-quiz/src/settings/: Preferences, model selection and service/library controls.
directories.docs/: Architecture, setup, refactor history and source inventory.

root_files.README.md: Primary user guide, setup, Markdown syntax, architecture overview, safety model and CLI operation.
root_files.requirements.txt: Python runtime dependency declaration. Currently documents Python 3.11+ and uses only the Python standard library; no third-party Python packages are required by the host application.
root_files.main.py: Root CLI entry point forwarding to markdown_quiz.main.
root_files.backend.py: Root HTTP backend launcher/compatibility entry point.
root_files.run_backend.py: Starts the HTTP API backend with project-relative defaults.
root_files.run_multiple_choice.py: Direct launcher for multiple-choice term sessions.
root_files.reset_json.py: Interactive reset utility for saved quiz collections, with backup behavior documented in README.
root_files.Dockerfile: Container image definition for the standalone application.
root_files..dockerignore: Files excluded from the application Docker build context.

python_modules.markdown_quiz/__init__.py: Marks the package and exposes package metadata/API as defined in the module.
python_modules.markdown_quiz/__main__.py: Enables python -m markdown_quiz by forwarding to the CLI.
python_modules.markdown_quiz/main.py: Interactive terminal CLI, commands, menus and user-facing quiz orchestration.
python_modules.markdown_quiz/config.py: Settings model, defaults, environment/CLI overrides, validation and persistence integration.
python_modules.markdown_quiz/notes/parser.py: ParsedTerm/ParsedCode definitions; vault reads, frontmatter extraction, scoped terms/code parsing, normalization and stable source IDs.
python_modules.markdown_quiz/notes/storage.py: Saved-record validation, atomic JSON reads/writes, source synchronization and reset/backups. ProgressRecord documents saved progress fields.
python_modules.markdown_quiz/backend.py: Owns loaded term/code collections, Markdown synchronization, persistence and the documented CLI question/answer operations.
python_modules.markdown_quiz/quiz/engine.py: SessionState and one shared quiz lifecycle: start, prepare, answer, record_attempt, advance, coding configuration, regeneration, drafts, retries and summaries.
python_modules.markdown_quiz/quiz/questions.py: Interactive coding AST variation, multiple blanks, reconstruction, output validation and grading. Historical filter imports directly re-export selection functions.
python_modules.markdown_quiz/quiz/term_quiz.py: Multiple-choice construction, cross-note distractor cache reuse and model generation/validation. Tested filter_tags compatibility import remains available.
python_modules.markdown_quiz/quiz/spaced_repetition.py: Mastery updates, review intervals, due dates and priority-based item selection.
python_modules.markdown_quiz/quiz/code_quiz.py: Established CLI LLM-generated one-blank code quizzes, caching, validation and sandbox grading; intentionally separate from interactive AST variation.
python_modules.markdown_quiz/services/ollama.py: Calls the local Ollama HTTP API for structured JSON generation; standard-library HTTP client.
python_modules.markdown_quiz/services/sandbox.py: Runs submitted/generated Python in constrained disposable Docker containers; applies resource/output/time limits and cleanup.
python_modules.markdown_quiz/api.py: HTTP API server and route handlers for plugin clients, synchronization, catalogs, quiz sessions and administration.
python_modules.markdown_quiz/services/cloud.py: Cloud/service API client helpers for remote generation or service requests, with URL and response handling.
python_modules.markdown_quiz/services/libraries.py: Validates optional Python package names and builds a dedicated Docker image with binary wheels for code-quiz execution; packages do not install into the host Python environment.
python_modules.markdown_quiz/quiz/selection.py: QuizFilters plus one eligibility/tag/date/source/due/ID filtering pipeline, shared by catalog and sessions; CLI uses its tag helpers.
python_modules.markdown_quiz/notes/__init__.py: Package marker; no forwarding layer or initialization work.
python_modules.markdown_quiz/quiz/__init__.py: Package marker; no forwarding layer or initialization work.
python_modules.markdown_quiz/services/__init__.py: Package marker; no forwarding layer or initialization work.

frontend_files.obsidian-markdown-quiz/src/views/questio: Shared multiple-choice, coding and error/recovery controls for sidebar and inline quizzes.
frontend_files.obsidian-markdown-quiz/src/views/inlineC: Inline code quiz widgets for Obsidian Reading view and editor Live Preview.

Locates Markdown code blocks and source positions for inline quiz placement.

frontend_files.obsidian-markdown-quiz/src/settings/sett: Plugin settings tab, defaults and preference controls.
frontend_files.obsidian-markdown-quiz/src/settings/libr: UI for selecting/installing optional Python packages used by coding exercises.
frontend_files.obsidian-markdown-quiz/src/settings/serv: Service/backend connection and related configuration controls.
frontend_files.obsidian-markdown-quiz/src/settings/mode: Model preferences (including migration fallback) and shared model/regeneration controls for sidebar and inline practice.
frontend_files.obsidian-markdown-quiz/src/types.ts: Central plugin settings, quiz actions, answer payloads and HTTP request/response types.

python_host_runtime.explanation: The Python application itself uses the Python standard library only. Docker, Ollama and Obsidian are external runtimes/services, not pip dependencies.

optional_user_selected_python_packages.purpose: Allow code exercises to import selected third-party Python packages.
optional_user_selected_python_packages.installation_target: A dedicated Docker image used by the sandbox, never the host interpreter.
optional_user_selected_python_packages.constraints: Up to 20 validated package names; binary wheels only; Python 3.13 slim base image; Docker required.
optional_user_selected_python_packages.note: These are selected by the user at runtime and are not fixed project dependencies.

tests.tests/test_engine.py: Shared quiz engine sessions and state transitions.

known_maintenance_boundary: Changes to Python backend behavior should normally be made in markdown_quiz/ and then copied/repackaged into plugin/markdown-quiz-generator/backend/ by the release workflow. Frontend changes belong in obsidian-markdown-quiz/src/ and should be built into the plugin package. Confirm the packaging script/workflow before manually changing generated copies.
